description: Hip-hop catalog from Sugar Hill (1979) through the end of the golden era / start of the bling era (1999). Style allowlist tuned to canonical Discogs style strings only — regional descriptors like 'East/West Coast Hip Hop', 'Bay Area', 'Southern Hip Hop' and 'Old School Hip Hop' are NOT Discogs styles (verified against catalog.master_styles), so they're omitted; Old-school catalog comes in via plain 'Hip Hop'. 'Electro' and 'Trap' are intentionally excluded — both are dominantly non-hip-hop in Discogs (Electro pulls 318k mostly-electronic masters; Trap is mostly post-1999 EDM-trap).
